A '''particle beam cannon''', often simply known as '''particle cannon''',<ref name="BF2-strat">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> was a weapon that utilized [[Particle beam/Legends|focused particles of energy]].

==History==
The [[AAC-1 speeder tank]] was known to be armed with two particle beam cannons.<ref name="BF2-strat" /><ref name="DB">{{DB|vehicle|aac1|AAC-1 speeder tank}}</ref>
